source_claim.article_title: 4 minute rule on polymarket: holy grail or trap?

decision_question: Do four consecutive same-direction one-minute BTC returns during the first four minutes of a UTC-aligned five-minute window predict the terminal direction strongly and stably enough to justify a separate, fee- and latency-aware Polymarket execution screen?

frozen_signal.window_alignment: UTC Unix timestamp divisible by 300 seconds
frozen_signal.checkpoint_price: last official Binance BTCUSDT one-second close observable at each checkpoint; the window-open checkpoint uses the first one-second open
frozen_signal.up_signal: each of P60-P0, P120-P60, P180-P120, and P240-P180 is strictly positive
frozen_signal.down_signal: each of P60-P0, P120-P60, P180-P120, and P240-P180 is strictly negative
frozen_signal.zero_return_rule: any zero one-minute return makes the condition ineligible
frozen_signal.terminal_price: last one-second close before the 300-second boundary
frozen_signal.terminal_up: terminal price strictly greater than the window-open price
frozen_signal.terminal_down: terminal price strictly less than the window-open price

public_proxy_data_contract.source: Official Binance public BTCUSDT spot one-second kline daily archives and adjacent SHA-256 checksum files
public_proxy_data_contract.fresh_window_reason: freshest complete daily archives ending before the protected forward-block interval; the July 14 archive is not opened
excluded_windows: 2026-03-23T13:30:30Z and earlier because the source article could have selected them
2026-07-14T00:00:00Z onward because active or sealed binary-complement conditions remain outcome-blind below 750

frozen_estimands.primary_grain: one prediction per eligible five-minute window
primary_metrics: UTC-day block-bootstrap 95 percent interval for continuation accuracy
diagnostic_only_slices: absolute first-two-minute move at least 100 USD
absolute first-two-minute move at least 200 USD
frozen_estimands.uncertainty: UTC-day block bootstrap with 10000 deterministic resamples and seed 20260722
frozen_estimands.economic_interpretation: directional accuracy is not executable edge; the per-trade break-even probability is executable token cost plus taker fee per share, not a fixed 51.02 percent

fixed_polymarket_screen_if_public_proxy_.authorization: implement one default-off research feature and exact replay only; do not change runtime behavior
fixed_polymarket_screen_if_public_proxy_.feature: four_minute_consistency with values consistent_up, consistent_down, inconsistent, or unavailable
fixed_polymarket_screen_if_public_proxy_.entry: earliest causal chosen-token book after offset 240 seconds plus at least 202 milliseconds insertion latency
fixed_polymarket_screen_if_public_proxy_.order: taker FOK using visible-depth book-walk VWAP and worst-price ceiling
fixed_polymarket_screen_if_public_proxy_.size: existing position budget, minimum order size, exposure cap, and projected stressed-drawdown cap
fixed_polymarket_screen_if_public_proxy_.fee: exact market fee metadata with the engine's fail-closed category fallback
fixed_polymarket_screen_if_public_proxy_.exit: hold to authoritative market resolution for the literal source-rule audit
comparisons: literal standalone rule versus no trade
existing candle_momentum baseline versus the same baseline requiring direction-matched four-minute consistency
required_outputs: eligible conditions, submitted orders, fills, and fill rate
entry ask, book-walk VWAP, worst price, slippage, and fee per share
realized accuracy and price-weighted break-even accuracy
net PnL, expectancy per filled share, profit factor, maximum drawdown, and longest losing streak
chronological fold, direction, weekday/weekend, UTC-hour, and entry-price stability
zero unresolved fills, breaker reconciliation errors, or settlement identity mismatches

decision_rules.public_proxy_pass: Proceed only to the frozen default-off Polymarket opportunity and exact-L2 screen.
decision_rules.public_proxy_fail: Reject four_minute_continuation_v1 without tuning checkpoint offsets, date windows, magnitude thresholds, hours, or directional gates on these labels.
decision_rules.polymarket_screen_pass: Retain as a default-off candidate and require a newest fully resolved, non-overlapping forward block before any promotion decision.
decision_rules.polymarket_screen_fail: Record a fee-, latency-, or robustness-based rejection; do not integrate into paper or live runtime.
